package.description: Free, open-source SSH terminal, SFTP file manager & S3 browser for macOS, Windows & Linux. Alternative to Termius.

en-US.description: Free, open-source SSH terminal, SFTP file manager & S3 browser for macOS, Windows & Linux. Alternative to Termius.
en-US.longDescription: AnySCP is a free, open-source desktop application that combines an SSH terminal, SFTP file explorer, and S3-compatible cloud storage browser into a single, fast, privacy-first tool. Built with Tauri v2 (Rust backend + React frontend), it runs natively on macOS, Windows, and Linux. No cloud accounts, no subscriptions -- your credentials stay on your machine.
en-US.name: anySCP
